description: This file contains functions for configuring trigger shapes and decoding GM LS24 crank wheel signals in an engine control system.

methods.name: configureGmTriggerShape
methods.description: Configures the trigger shape with specific event timings for GM trigger signals.

methods.name: gm_tooth_pair
methods.description: Calculates and adds a tooth pair event to the trigger shape based on the start angle and gap pattern.

methods.name: initGmLS24
methods.description: Initializes the trigger shape for GM LS24 crank wheel with pattern decoding and synchronization gaps.
